items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Then I went to work for an old Russian named Romansky.

ctx.x: And then the old men, they smoking cigars all through it. They didn't want no ventilation and they spit on the floor and the tobacco's on the floor and all that. And I saw all that and I began to get disgusted and sick of -- and I just quit.

Then I went to work for an old Russian named Romansky. He was a photo engraver and used to work for the newspaper. And I made more money working with him, making prints, you know, for the Sunday paper and all that, and I stayed with him for a couple of years. I was real good.
How old were you when you worked in the cigar factory?
